info.title: TravelMapster API
info.description: The JSON API the TravelMapster app uses. It is version 1 and changes only in backward-compatible ways ([ADR 0019](../adr/0019-api-description-and-versioning.md)). Errors are `{ "error": "…" }` with a matching status; every response is `Cache-Control: no-store` unless stated.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Required on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE: the token from `GET /api/csrf-token` or the last auth response.

CsrfRejected.description: Missing or wrong CSRF token (`code: CSRF`)

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this client IP; standard `RateLimit` headers say when to retry

code.description: `CSRF` when the CSRF token is missing or wrong.

password.description: At most 72 bytes in UTF-8; never trimmed.

website.description: Sign-up only: a honeypot field people never see. Anything in it refuses the sign-up.

publicIndexing.description: Whether search engines may list the map while it is public (ADR 0023).

goals.description: Yearly goals, sorted by year and kind; never on the public map.

packingTemplates.description: Packing list templates to start a trip's list from, each with its own name; never on the public map.

csrfToken.description: The token for the new session.

ProfileChanges.description: Each setting is optional; send at least one.

homeCountry.description: A map code, or null or empty to clear it.

publicIndexing.description: Whether search engines may list the map while it is public (ADR 0023).

goals.description: Replaces every goal; one per kind and year.

packingTemplates.description: Packing list templates to start a trip's list from, each with its own name; never on the public map.

endDate.description: On or after the start; empty when not recorded or still going on.

ongoing.description: Still there: no end date yet.

purpose.description: Personal by default; left out of an update, the stored purpose stays.

organizationId.description: For a business visit: one of the caller's organizations.

companions.description: Names of who came along, each once regardless of case; never on the public map. Left out of an update, the stored ones stay.

stay.description: How the traveler was at a place been to (ADR 0014); always `visit` for the wishlist.

tags.description: Lowercased; letters and digits with inner spaces, dashes, apostrophes or ampersands.

travelDate.description: Legacy single date (ADR 0009): becomes a visit; on an update it only ever adds one.

visits.description: Creating and importing only; wins over travelDate.

BulkChanges.description: Between 1 and 300 changes in all, applied all or nothing; each place changed or removed at most once.

LedgerRule.description: A stay rule (`kind: stay`, at most maxDays in any windowDays) or a threshold (`kind: threshold`, over a year from yearStart or a rolling window).

LedgerExemption.description: A period under a residence permit or long-stay visa: the days in its countries from its first to its last day do not count toward stay rules.

stops.description: The destinations of a trip with several, in order, each with its days; empty for a trip to its one destination. Left out on an update, the stored stops are kept.

packing.description: Left out on an update, the stored list is kept.

budget.description: Left out on an update, the stored budget is kept.

updatedAt.description: The version the trip was edited from; a trip saved by someone else since is refused with 409.

organizationId.description: A business trip for one of the caller's organizations; null makes it personal, and left out the stored one stays. Only the owner changes it (ADR 0030).

owner.description: The owner's username for a trip shared with the caller, else null.

markers.description: Without notes, photo links, ratings, tags, emoji, wishlist plans or hidden places.

security.description: How the account signs in, without keys or secrets (ADR 0027).

kind.description: New countries or cities first visited in the year, or visits begun in it.

TripBudget.description: Empty for no budget. Expenses are totalled in `currency` with the traveler's own exchange rates (units of `currency` for one unit of another).

secondStep.description: Two-step sign-in is on: send a code to POST /api/auth/login/second-step to open the session.

SessionInfo.description: A device signed in: the browser and system read from its User-Agent when it signed in (null when unknown or before this was recorded), named by a hash of the session id.

SecurityEvent.description: A sign-in or a change to how the account signs in, with the browser and system names of the device (null when unknown).

sessions.description: Open sessions, the most recently used first.

activity.description: The latest security activity, newest first.

WebAuthnOptions.description: PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON or PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON (WebAuthn Level 3), binary fields in base64url.

WebAuthnResponse.description: The credential as RegistrationResponseJSON or AuthenticationResponseJSON (WebAuthn Level 3), binary fields in base64url.

public.description: False once the map went private; the follow stays until dropped.

rules.description: The employer's rules, counted on business visits for it.

token.description: Only in the response that creates it; the link is `/#join=<token>`.

actor.description: Null once that account is deleted.

OrgReport.description: Business days only; no place names, cities, dates or notes. A rule's forecast counts the member's business trips planned ahead as planned days, without their destinations or dates.

reachDate.description: Thresholds: the day it is or would be reached.

forecast.description: With the business trips planned ahead: whether a stay rule still fits and its first day over, or a threshold's days and whether they reach it. Null without planned trips.

plannedTrips.description: Business trips planned ahead counted in the forecast.

unknownTrips.description: Business trips planned ahead to no known place, left out of the forecast.

ChecklistItem.description: A task an organization asks of its travelers before a business trip to some countries (ADR 0030).

daysBefore.description: Due this many days before the trip starts.

link.description: An HTTP or HTTPS link to the official page.

CalendarFeedLink.description: The private link, shown once: only a hash of its token is stored.

url.description: An iCalendar feed of the traveler's dated trips and planned stays, fetched without a session.
